provenance.difference: New teaching boundary: Evaluate without deploying. Existing boundary: The learner can explain that after n nines the gap to 1 is 0.00...01 (one tenth of the previous gap), so with all the nines the gap would have to be smaller than every such number; the only such non-negative number is 0, so 0.999... = 1.
